messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "blood thinners and antiplatelet medicines"
set: ["blood thinners and antiplatelet medicines", "other antiplatelet medicines", "blood thinners indirectly", "other blood pressure medicines", "combination blood pressure medicines", "medicines that lower blood pressure", "includes prescription and over-the-counter medicines", "taking other medicines to lower blood sugar", "blood thinner or other medicines to treat or prevent blood clots", "some HIV and hepatitis C medicines", "medicines", "protects heart and blood vessels", "regular blood tests and check-ups", "protein and blood in urine", "fatal and non-fatal heart and blood vessel events", "relaxing and widening the blood vessels"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
